notes: 2.3.1: biome scans are command-only and scan the WHOLE world in one go. The background timer is gone - run /bridge biomes rescan all (or now) to fill the map; a rescan covers every region file, so the map shows all generated chunks, not just the few nearest spawn. The old regions-per-scan budget limited every command (even 'rescan all') to ~3 regions total, which is why only a handful of sections near spawn ever loaded - it's removed. scan-seconds and regions-per-scan are dropped from the biomes remote config. Includes the hollow-chunk fix (top biome layer + single-entry palettes with no data array). After updating, run /bridge biomes rescan all once. Requires the 20260101000300_biomes migration and the 20260101000500_biomes_snapshot RPC for the website.
